description: This Java class defines an Android Fragment called ElevationDragFragment that manages a draggable view with adjustable elevation, including outline shape and drag interactions.

classes.name: ElevationDragFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages a draggable view with adjustable elevation and custom outline shape.

classes.name: CircleOutlineProvider
classes.description: A private inner class extending ViewOutlineProvider to set the outline as an oval fitting the view bounds.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the outline provider and elevation step size.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, sets up the draggable view, outline, and button click handlers for changing elevation.

methods.name: CircleOutlineProvider.getOutline
methods.description: Defines the oval outline shape for the view.
